description: F (Fisher-Snedecor) distribution survival function 1 - F(x; d1, d2)

tolerance.reason: 1 - F, with f_cdf's tolerance for the same reasons: the condition number |x f / (1 - F)| reaches 1549 at a normal result (d1 = d2 = 1e5, x = 1.063), about 1.7e-13 per rounding of z or y, and the prefix logarithms reach 1.05e6, so separately rounded logarithms can cost 1.2e-10. Computed from y = d2 / (d1 x + d2) directly, the upper tail keeps full relative precision for every x, which this tolerance demands down to the smallest normal double. SciPy's worst error at the points it gets within tolerance is 8.6e-13 (d1 = 30, d2 = 1e5, x = 5); it fails 11: 1.0e-12 to 2.4e-12 at d2 = 1e5 with d1 = 10 or 30, and 1 instead of 1 - 6.4e-11 at d1 = d2 = 1, x = 1e-20 (the closed form confirms mpmath)
